messages:
anna_pm: Quick huddle re: BlueHarbor SI onboarding and co-sell rules. They want a managed services listing + co-sell on enterprise deals. Need a clear SFDC mapping, marketplace exceptions, and announcement gating. Who can own the intake workflow?

ryan_bd: Met with their BD — two commercial models: reseller for appliance bundles and services-led engagements. Marketplace should only publish appliance SKU; services should be partner-booked.

jess_ops: Can we carve regulated verticals out? BlueHarbor requires direct contracting for gov/healthcare. We need automation so marketplace checkouts for those don't orphan leads.

anna_pm: My initial proposal: marketplace_checkout -> PartnerOps triage queue; partner_sourced -> BlueHarbor SDR/AE; existing_redwood_account -> Redwood AE keeps primary. Exceptions table to codify. OK?

priya_legal: Heads-up: co-branded announcement needs 10 business days review, sign-off on logo use, and SOW owner clarified. BlueHarbor wants to sign implementation SOWs; Redwood should own platform MSA unless partner is reseller.

ryan_bd: Suggested SFDC mapping (csv-friendly):
```
account_type,lead_source,primary_owner,secondary_credit
existing_redwood,manual,redwood_ae,blueharbor_delivery
partner_sourced,partner_form,blueharbor_ae,redwood_revenue_share
marketplace_checkout,marketplace,partnerops_queue,none
regulated_vertical,manual,blueharbor_direct,redwood_notify
```
Let's add partner_tag + handshake_date fields for automation.

anna_pm: Agree. Add rule: if Redwood AE has active open opp in last 12 months -> Redwood retains handle and partner gets delivery credit. If no prior contact and marketplace checkout -> PartnerOps qualifies then route to BlueHarbor.

jess_ops: Operational: add tag blueharbor_direct_exempt for flagged accounts so routing picks it up. PartnerOps to own qualification script + Slack notification channel #partners-routing.

sd-bot: :reminder: Co-marketing assets due in 12 days. Create PR under /marketing/partners/blueharbor with logo + one-pager.

ryan_bd: For rollout, propose pilot cohort of 4 customers (mix of self-serve and field) to validate routing and billing flows before public marketplace listing. BlueHarbor has 3 prospects ready.

priya_legal: I'll draft a 1-page announcement agreement and a checklist for who signs SOW vs MSA. Also propose monthly revenue reconciliation cadence.

anna_pm: Next steps:
- @jess_ops -> build SFDC flow + tags (ETA 72h)
- @priya_legal -> announcement + contracting checklist (ETA 5 business days)
- @ryan_bd -> schedule pilot cohort + joint demos (ETA 10 business days)
- @anna_pm -> draft partner ops SOP for routing and crediting (ETA 4 days)

anna_pm: If no objections I'll freeze this playbook and circulate to execs for sign-off tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

ryan_bd: :thumbsup:

jess_ops: on it.

priya_legal: starting draft now. :memo:

sd-bot: :white_check_mark: Actions logged: sfdc-flow (jess_ops), legal-announcement (priya_legal), pilot-cohort (ryan_bd), sop-draft (anna_pm).
